from.place: Proof of Lemma 07CH: Fibrewise flatness of an unramified smooth chart

title: Fibrewise flatness of an unramified smooth chart
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, n,c natural numbers, f_j in P=R[x_1,...,x_n], J=(f_j) and C=P/J [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Assume C is smooth over R [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map] and J/J^2 has a C-basis indexed by Fin c. For every g in D=C[y_1,...,y_c] and every R-algebra map theta:P -> D_g [def-weil-ring-localization-away], if D_g is formally unramified over P through theta [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials], then it is flat over P through that same theta [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. No prescribed values for the conormal basis or theta are assumed.

source.place: Proof of Lemma 07CH, corrected coordinates, Nakayama localization and fibrewise flatness; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07CH

proof.text: Apply the proved differential-basis theorem to obtain Omega(B/R) free of rank n. Polynomial smoothness and principal-localization smoothness make B smooth over R.

Formal unramifiedness gives Omega(B/P)=0. The fundamental differential sequence, KaehlerDifferential.exact_mapBaseChange_map, makes d:B tensor_P Omega(P/R) -> Omega(B/R) surjective. The base-changed polynomial basis and chart basis identify its source and target. Conjugate d to an endomorphism of a finite free B-module and apply Module.End.injective_of_surjective, the free-module case of the finite-module endomorphism theorem. Thus d is injective too.

Use only Mathlib Algebra.H1Cotangent.exact_map_delta and exact_delta_mapBaseChange, the already proved portions of the Jacobi-Zariski sequence (Lean spells delta with the Greek letter). Smoothness over R kills H1(L(B/R)), so the connecting map out of H1(L(B/P)) is injective; its image lies in ker d=0. Thus H1(L(B/P))=0. Together with Omega(B/P)=0, the FormallySmooth constructor proves formal smoothness over P.

Apply Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_restrict_scalars_finitePresentation to R -> P -> B; P is finite type over R and B finitely presented over R by smoothness. Construct Smooth P B and apply Algebra.Smooth.flat P B.

proof_origin.place: Shorter differential argument using Tags 00S2 and 031J, after the split conormal stabilization in Stacks 07CH. Reuses only the proved Mathlib portions of the Jacobi-Zariski sequence, not the stronger Sheaf theorem.
